referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Gate to gate inventory for an improved Czochralski process. Crushing of Si, etching with HNO3, HF and acetic acid. Melting in a silica pot and crystallisation to produce a monocrystalline material. Water emissions roughly estimated. Process emissions to air are not known.

geography.text: Data for RER, extrapolated to Chinese production.

technology.text: Czochralski process for production of monocrystalline silicon blocks. Than edges are sliced and blocks are sawn.

timePeriod.text: Most data are published in 2006. Electricity demand updated for 2018. Some older data published in 1992.

representativeness.extrapolations: Extrapolation of European LCI data by changing the electricity mix.
representativeness.productionVolume: Approximately 105000 MW for total c-Si in 2018
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Publication of plant specific (partly aggregated) data and literature information.
